feature: Project application audit and human-reviewed agent learning loop

flows.name: Use the canonical project portfolio
steps: Exercise search, scope filters, view settings, and table settings
Navigate through the legacy /projects entry point
flows.expectedOutcome: The canonical portfolio owns the route and its shared controls respond without a duplicate page implementation

flows.name: Create an accessible bootstrap project
steps: Verify default roles and request-scoped identity
flows.expectedOutcome: The project is created once, its role trigger passes RLS, and its creator can immediately open project pages

flows.name: Reject and correct an agent learning candidate
steps: Open the learning-review queue as an app admin
Surface any late audit-write failure accurately
flows.expectedOutcome: The unapproved proposal is rejected, the administrator's correction becomes scoped active learning, and partial outcomes never report false success or false failure

flows.name: Identify automatic training ownership
steps: Inspect the deployed weekly resource finder
Trace admin publication and learning promotion consumers
flows.expectedOutcome: Existing automation and review owners are proven, while no-op or incomplete automation is reported explicitly

checks: Learning queue remains focused on the review decision
Corrective feedback is visibly required before rejection

claims.description: The legacy projects route resolves to the canonical portfolio and representative shared controls work
Bootstrap project creation is repeatable, creates roles under RLS, and grants the creator protected-route access
App admins can review candidates and meaningful rejection feedback reaches active scoped learning
Activation, destination linking, and audit recording have accurate, recoverable outcomes
Scheduled resource discovery, review queues, runtime consumers, and remaining automation gaps are identified
